duty_lines: Main tent — Twin SF1000 is the live 4×8 actuator (on/off + brightness). Hub GPIO5 is
for Twin PWM — not physically wired yet. Got prefers Twin on-hours when history is healthy; otherwise the photoperiod window (Got · Twin).
Opens at 06:00:00 · 12 h window (mirrored from 4×8). Edit the 4×8 card to change timing, or switch Schedule source to Independent.

key_lines: Clone climate mode is Follow 4×8 — Want targets lock here. Edit 4×8 climate or change mode below.

Follow 4×8 mirrors main stage targets. Follow Plants intersects Want for 2×4 plants (Pi, ~12h). Custom leaves sliders alone. Off parks the 2×4. Photoperiod follow is on Light — separate from climate mode.
